question: WHY does current SCI OS startup still call installer/scripts/start-meta-os.cjs?
answer: It does NOT. SCI OS ×10 (scios-alpha) canonical path is bootstrap-capsule.cjs → start-sci-os.cjs. start-meta-os.cjs lives in sibling GalaxusMetaOS tree and is LEGACY_META_OS_OUT_OF_TREE.

metaOs.action: DEPRECATE_FROM_SCI_OS_PRODUCT — do not wire into scios-alpha boot

namingNote: Meta-OS naming in recovery packages (meta-recovery) is recovery tooling, not Meta OS orchestrator.
